description: Managing Director at NevisWealth. High-net-worth fintech executive looking for comprehensive estate planning, revocable living trust setup, and multi-jurisdictional tax optimization between London and New York.
Chief Operating Officer at NevisWealth and spouse of John Doe. Focused on philanthropic giving, donor-advised funds (DAF), and family foundation governance.
Head of Quantitative Research at NevisWealth. Interested in alternative investments, private equity capital calls, and concentrated stock option diversification.
VP of Institutional Partnerships. Needs Lombard lending (securities-backed line of credit) for a residential property acquisition in Zurich.
General Partner at Apex Capital focusing on Series B enterprise AI startups. Requires carried interest structuring, Delaware statutory trusts, and QSBS (Qualified Small Business Stock) tax planning.
Managing Partner at Apex Capital. Dual US-Singapore tax resident seeking FATCA and CRS cross-border compliance, foreign bank account reporting (FBAR), and Asian family office administration.
Sovereign wealth advisor and venture partner at Apex Capital based in Dubai and London. Specializes in Sharia-compliant private credit, sukuk fixed income, and commercial real estate syndications.

Chief Legal Officer at Apex Capital. Preparing for an upcoming secondary liquidity event; needs umbrella liability insurance review, irrevocable life insurance trust (ILIT), and 401(k) rollover advice.
Co-founder and Chief Scientific Officer at Vanguardia Therapeutics. Holds substantial pre-IPO biotech equity grants, patent royalty streams, and Rule 10b5-1 trading plan documentation.

SVP of Clinical Operations at Vanguardia Bio. French national residing in Boston; requires cross-border pension consolidation, US Green Card tax residency planning, and education trust setup for two children.
Board Director at Vanguardia Bio and former pharmaceutical CEO. Portfolio heavily weighted in Nordic equities, sovereign bonds, and timberland real assets.

Senior Partner at Meridian Ventures in Mayfair, London. Focuses on UK Self-Invested Personal Pensions (SIPP), Enterprise Investment Scheme (EIS) tax relief, and Cotswolds agricultural estate succession.
Principal at Meridian Ventures covering European fintech and climate tech. Looking for first-time prime London mortgage structuring and discretionary portfolio management.
Operating Partner at Meridian Ventures. Recently exited a B2B SaaS company for GBP 45M; onboarding KYC, proof of address, and source of wealth verification in progress.
Head of Investor Relations at Meridian Ventures. Manages family trust distributions, fine art and vintage watch appraisals, and charitable endowment pledges.

Founder and CEO of Solaris Energy GmbH in Munich. Clean-tech entrepreneur after a EUR 120M majority buyout; focused on ESG impact investing, German GmbH holding structures, and renewable infrastructure funds.
Chief Financial Officer at Solaris Energy. Seeking euro-denominated fixed-term treasury deposits, currency hedging against USD/CHF, and executive deferred compensation planning.
VP of Grid Engineering at Solaris Energy. Italian citizen working in Berlin; holds residential rental properties in Milan and Lake Como requiring property management and cross-border tax filings.
Director of Project Finance at Solaris Energy. Interested in green bonds, inflation-protected securities, and family wealth transfer for beneficiaries in Madrid and Frankfurt.

Retired cardiothoracic surgeon and angel investor. Co-founder and early seed backer of NevisWealth. Currently managing required minimum distributions (RMDs), defined benefit pension annuities, and long-term care insurance.

Contemporary art gallerist and collector in Paris and Geneva. Wealth derived from inheritance and gallery sales; requires fine art provenance insurance, collectibles valuation, and dynasty trust administration.

Early blockchain protocol architect and Web3 founder. Holds institutional digital asset custody accounts, staked ETH/BTC positions, venture token warrants, and Puerto Rico Act 60 tax residency certificates.

Principal of the Chen Single Family Office in San Francisco. Oversees 1031 like-kind commercial real estate exchanges, direct private credit lending, and multi-generational family governance charters.
Former professional ATP tennis player and hospitality entrepreneur in Monaco. Invests in luxury boutique hotels, yacht charter syndicates, and global dividend growth equities.
